recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. No terminology change is recommended because the code remains 'provider' in the payeetype code system; the resource definitions now provide the missing clarification requested by the applied Jira issue.
issue_request: FHIR-37879 was Applied and resolved Persuasive with Modification. It requested clarification that Claim/ClaimResponse/ExplanationOfBenefit payee.type and payee descriptions indicate that payee type 'provider' means the party specified in the provider element, i.e. the billing provider.
initial_application: Commit ee3ca87b00, merged by 79f858d3e9, applied FHIR-37879 by replacing generic provider wording with billing provider wording in the payee text. That application was incomplete because it did not explicitly connect the 'provider' payee type to Claim.provider, ClaimResponse.requestor, or ExplanationOfBenefit.provider, and Claim.payee.type still listed only provider without the requested explanation.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Claim, ClaimResponse, and ExplanationOfBenefit as active resources. In the current R6 source, ClaimResponse uses ClaimResponse.requestor rather than ClaimResponse.provider, and that element is documented as the billing provider. Quoted Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Updated source/claim/structuredefinition-Claim.xml, source/claimresponse/structuredefinition-ClaimResponse.xml, and source/explanationofbenefit/structuredefinition-ExplanationOfBenefit.xml. The payee definitions now state that 'provider' means the billing provider specified in Claim.provider, ClaimResponse.requestor, or ExplanationOfBenefit.provider as appropriate.
source_changes: source/claim/structuredefinition-Claim.xml: clarified Claim.payee and Claim.payee.type definitions to point provider payees to Claim.provider.
source/claimresponse/structuredefinition-ClaimResponse.xml: clarified ClaimResponse.payeeType to point provider payees to the current billing-provider element, ClaimResponse.requestor.

source/explanationofbenefit/structuredefinition-ExplanationOfBenefit.xml: clarified ExplanationOfBenefit.payee and ExplanationOfBenefit.payee.type definitions to point provider payees to ExplanationOfBenefit.provider.
